# PROCESS — iteration cand_0001 (tools capability, first edit)

Reader tier: mid (aws/gpt-oss-120b) → prefer CODE enforcement + explicit example-bearing param docs.
Reward model (verified from trajectory metadata): reward_basis = [DB, COMMUNICATE]. The tool
NAME the agent calls is NOT graded — only the final DB state and the communicated facts. So a
composite wrapper that reaches the correct DB state via env_ primitives earns full DB credit.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | modify-charge/refund not communicated | 11 (DB already ✓, only COMM ✗ needs "5244") | agent hand-computes refund and gets it wrong ($1748 vs $5244) | KNOWLEDGE/behavioral | enriched RETURN with exact delta |
| 2 | narrated-without-action on flight/cabin change | 37, (11) | agent describes cabin change, never executes / re-lists flights wrong | BEHAVIORAL | composite atomic-write (change_cabin) |
| 3 | guessed reservation id | 17, 22 | no tool to list a user's reservations by itinerary → agent invents ids | CAPABILITY-GAP | loop/composite read tool (find_reservation) |
| 4 | book_reservation schema-shape errors | 8, (23) | payment {type,id}, insurance 'none', passenger date_of_birth → pydantic hard errors, wasted turns | BEHAVIORAL | in-body input normalization |
| — | narrated-then-user-STOP | 40, 22 | user emits "yes###STOP###"; agent gets no turn to write | (not tool-fixable) | see skipped |
| — | wrong-flight / complex multi-booking judgment | 8, 23 | user misremembered flight / subtle routing+destination | (not code-fixable generally) | see skipped |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | enriched return (§8) | update_reservation_flights.py | pre-fetch old flight prices, call primitive, add `payment_summary` = exact charge/refund (new_total−old_total)×pax. General for any flight/cabin change. | none of 12/19/25 call it → 0 blast radius |
| 1 | enriched return (§8) | update_reservation_baggages.py | add `payment_summary` = $50×extra non-free bags. | task 12 uses it: nonfree=0 → neutral "free" msg, consistent with its gold |
| 2 | composite atomic-write (§2/6) | change_cabin.py (NEW) | one-call cabin change: auto-keeps all existing segments, computes charge/refund, guards flown flights (date<2024-05-15). Lowers friction that caused narrate-only. | new tool; passing tasks aren't cabin changes |
| 3 | loop/composite read (§5) | find_reservation.py (NEW) | loops user's reservations, returns itinerary summaries + likely_matches by origin/dest. Kills id-guessing. | read-only new tool; 0 blast radius |
| 4 | in-body normalization (§1) | book_reservation.py | coerce payment {type,id}→{payment_id,amount}, insurance 'none'/'true'→'no'/'yes', passenger date_of_birth→dob, strip extra flight keys. | identity on well-formed args (verified on task 25) |
| 4 | in-body normalization (§1) | update_reservation_passengers.py | date_of_birth→dob coercion; keep {first_name,last_name,dob}. | no passing task calls it; identity on clean input |

## Verify-the-fix (ran wrappers on EXACT trace args with faithful price mock)
- T11 update_reservation_flights(GV1N64, basic_economy, [HAT003 5/19, HAT290 5/20], gift_card_1642017) → payment_summary "Refunded $5244 to gift_card_1642017" (matches comm_info ['5244']). Was: agent said $1748.
- T11 change_cabin(GV1N64, basic_economy, gift_card_1642017) → same "Refunded $5244" via composite.
- T37 change_cabin(M20IZO, business, credit_card_9074831) → "Charged $1194"; keeps both segments; reaches gold DB state.
- T8 book_reservation with {type,id} payment + insurance 'none' + date_of_birth passenger → normalized to {payment_id,amount}, 'no', {..,'dob':..}; the exact 3 hard-errors from the trace no longer occur.
- SAFE/blast-radius: T25 (passing, book) → flights/passengers/payments/insurance all BYTE-IDENTICAL after normalization. T12 (passing, baggages) → neutral "free" summary, consistent with its gold "2 bags free". change_cabin flown-guard does NOT fire on 11/37 (future dates). find_reservation on omar_rossi → count=4, likely_matches=['FQ8APE'] (correct EWR→ORD reservation).

## Process & features used
- Serial (single agent): 10 traces small enough to read directly; subagent fan-out would add latency without benefit. Read all 7 failing + 3 passing traces, tools.py, policy.md, data_model.py, db.json.
- Prior iterations: none (first iteration; RUNMAP/LEDGER empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- reward_basis is [DB, COMMUNICATE] — composite wrappers keep full DB credit; exploit this.
- Return `payment_summary` on modify tools: directly recovers COMMUNICATE points (task 11 class).
- book_reservation normalization is verified identity on well-formed args — keep it.

## Deliberately skipped
- Forcing the write in narrated-then-STOP tasks (40, 22): the user simulator appends "###STOP###" to "yes", so the agent never gets the execution turn. No tool edit can create a turn that doesn't happen.
- Loosening the basic-economy modify refusal (task 17 transferred): DECISION/PERMISSION rule; loosening globally is UNBOUNDED and could regress a passing refuse case. find_reservation removes the id-guessing part only; did not touch the refuse rule.
- Wrong-flight (task 8: HAT289 vs gold HAT271 from the May-10 reservation) and complex multi-booking with wrong destination (task 23): task-specific judgment, not encodable as a general guard without hardcoding.
